verdict.rationale: FFmpeg ships official first-party C libraries (libavformat, libavfilter, libavdevice) with nightly-regenerated Doxygen API docs and coding examples in doc/examples. Community users confirm the C API is usable but report that API docs and tutorials are sparse or outdated, and that the API makes invalid states easy to represent. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond the C libraries (e.g. Python/JS bindings), up-to-date API tutorials and guides, independent corroboration that the API documentation is adequate.
